title: Microsoft Says New Cybersecurity AI Model Helps MDASH Hit 95.95% at Half the Cost
summary: Microsoft has launched its first cybersecurity-specific model inside MDASH, its multi-model vulnerability identification and remediation harness.
card_summary: Microsoft has launched its first cybersecurity-specific model inside MDASH, its multi-model vulnerability identification and remediation harness.

sections.mitigation: It also claims the configuration costs 50% less than its current best MDASH combination of GPT-5.4, GPT-5.4 mini, and GPT-5.3 Codex.

email_summary: Microsoft has launched its first cybersecurity-specific model inside MDASH, its multi-model vulnerability identification and remediation harness. The company says MDASH, using MAI-Cyber-1-Flash and GPT-5.4, scored 95.95% on CyberGym.

title: Attackers Exploit Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator Command Injection Flaw
